verses.en: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations;
verses.pt: E aconteceu nos dias de Anrafel, rei de Sinear, Arioque, rei de Elasar, Quedorlaomer, rei de Elão, e Tidal, rei de nações,
verses.en_web: In the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar, Arioch, king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer, king of Elam, and Tidal, king of Goiim,
verses.en_bbe: Now in the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar, Arioch, king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer, king of Elam, and Tidal, king of Goiim,

verses.en: That these made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, which is Zoar.
verses.pt: Que estes fizeram guerra contra Bera, rei de Sodoma, e contra Birsa, rei de Gomorra, e contra Sinabe, rei de Admá, e contra Semeber, rei de Zeboim, e contra o rei de Belá, a qual é Zoar.
verses.en_web: they made war with Bera, king of Sodom, and with Birsha, king of Gomorrah, Shinab, king of Admah, and Shemeber, king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (also called Zoar).
verses.en_bbe: They made war with Bera, king of Sodom, and with Birsha, king of Gomorrah, Shinab, king of Admah, and Shemeber, king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (which is Zoar).

verses.en: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea.
verses.pt: Todos estes se juntaram no vale de Sidim, que é o mar salgado.
verses.en_web: All these joined together in the valley of Siddim (also called the Salt Sea).
verses.en_bbe: All these came together in the valley of Siddim (which is the Salt Sea).

verses.en: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
verses.pt: Doze anos haviam servido a Quedorlaomer, e ao décimo terceiro ano se rebelaram.
verses.en_web: They served Chedorlaomer for twelve years, and in the thirteenth year, they rebelled.
verses.en_bbe: For twelve years they were under the rule of Chedorlaomer, but in the thirteenth year they put off his control.

verses.en: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer, and the kings that were with him, and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzims in Ham, and the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim,
verses.pt: E no ano décimo quarto veio Quedorlaomer, e os reis que estavam de sua parte, e derrotaram aos refains em Asterote-Carnaim, aos zuzins em Hã, e aos emins em Savé-Quiriataim.
verses.en_web: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer came, and the kings who were with him, and struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzim in Ham, and the Emim in Shaveh Kiriathaim,
verses.en_bbe: And in the fourteenth year, Chedorlaomer and the kings who were on his side, overcame the Rephaim in Ashteroth-karnaim, and the Zuzim in Ham, and the Emim in Shaveh-kiriathaim,

verses.en: And the Horites in their mount Seir, unto El-paran, which is by the wilderness.
verses.pt: E aos horeus no monte de Seir, até a El-Parã, que está junto ao deserto.
verses.en_web: and the Horites in their Mount Seir, to El Paran, which is by the wilderness.
verses.en_bbe: And the Horites in their mountain Seir, driving them as far as El-paran, which is near the waste land.

verses.en: And they returned, and came to En-mishpat, which is Kadesh, and smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites that dwelt in Hazezon-tamar.
verses.pt: E voltaram e vieram a En-Mispate, que é Cades, e devastaram todas as terras dos amalequitas, e também aos amorreus, que habitavam em Hazazom-Tamar.
verses.en_web: They returned, and came to En Mishpat (also called Kadesh), and struck all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that lived in Hazazon Tamar.
verses.en_bbe: Then they came back to En-mishpat (which is Kadesh), making waste all the country of the Amalekites and of the Amorites living in Hazazon-tamar.

verses.en: And there went out the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar;) and they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim;
verses.pt: E saiu o rei de Sodoma, e o rei de Gomorra, e o rei de Admá, e o rei de Zeboim, e o rei de Belá, que é Zoar, e ordenaram contra eles batalha no vale de Sidim;
verses.en_web: The king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (also called Zoar) went out; and they set the battle in array against them in the valley of Siddim;
verses.en_bbe: And the king of Sodom with the king of Gomorrah and the king of Admah and the king of Zeboiim and the king of Bela (that is Zoar), went out, and put their forces in position in the valley of Siddim,

verses.en: With Chedorlaomer the king of Elam, and with Tidal king of nations, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings with five.
verses.pt: A saber, contra Quedorlaomer, rei de Elão, e Tidal, rei de nações, e Anrafel, rei de Sinear, e Arioque, rei de Elasar; quatro reis contra cinco.
verses.en_web: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of Goiim, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings against the five.
verses.en_bbe: Against Chedorlaomer, king of Elam, and Tidal, king of Goiim, and Amraphel, king of Shinar, and Arioch, king of Ellasar: four kings against the five.

verses.en: And the vale of Siddim was full of slimepits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.
verses.pt: E o vale de Sidim estava cheio de poços de betume: e fugiram o rei de Sodoma e o de Gomorra, e caíram ali; e os demais fugiram ao monte.
verses.en_web: Now the valley of Siddim was full of tar pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and some fell there, and those who remained fled to the hills.
verses.en_bbe: Now the valley of Siddim was full of holes of sticky earth; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah were put to flight and came to their end there, but the rest got away to the mountain.

verses.en: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their victuals, and went their way.
verses.pt: E tomaram toda a riqueza de Sodoma e de Gomorra, e todos os seus mantimentos, e se foram.
verses.en_web: They took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their food, and went their way.
verses.en_bbe: And the four kings took all the goods and food from Sodom and Gomorrah and went on their way.

verses.en: And they took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
verses.pt: Tomaram também Ló, filho do irmão de Abrão, que morava em Sodoma, e sua riqueza, e se foram.
verses.en_web: They took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who lived in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
verses.en_bbe: And in addition they took Lot, Abram's brother's son, who was living in Sodom, and all his goods.

verses.en: And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner: and these were confederate with Abram.
verses.pt: E veio um dos que escaparam, e denunciou-o a Abrão o hebreu, que habitava no vale de Manre, amorreu, irmão de Escol e irmão de Aner, os quais tinham feito pacto com Abrão.
verses.en_web: One who had escaped came and told Abram, the Hebrew. At that time, he lived by the oaks of Mamre, the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner; and they were allies of Abram.
verses.en_bbe: And one who had got away from the fight came and gave word of it to Abram the Hebrew, who was living by the holy tree of Mamre, the Amorite, the brother of Eshcol and Aner, who were friends of Abram.

verses.en: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his trained servants, born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued them unto Dan.
verses.pt: E ouviu Abrão que seu irmão estava prisioneiro, e armou seus criados, os criados de sua casa, trezentos e dezoito, e seguiu-os até Dã.
verses.en_web: When Abram heard that his relative was taken captive, he led out his trained men, born in his house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued as far as Dan.
verses.en_bbe: And Abram, hearing that his brother's son had been made a prisoner, took a band of his trained men, three hundred and eighteen of them, sons of his house, and went after them as far as Dan.

verses.en: And he divided himself against them, he and his servants, by night, and smote them, and pursued them unto Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.
verses.pt: E derramou-se sobre eles de noite ele e seus servos, e feriu-os, e foi os seguindo até Hobá, que está à esquerda de Damasco.
verses.en_web: He divided himself against them by night, he and his servants, and struck them, and pursued them to Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.
verses.en_bbe: And separating his forces by night, he overcame them, putting them to flight and going after them as far as Hobah, which is on the north side of Damascus.

verses.en: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought again his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.
verses.pt: E recuperou todos os bens, e também a Ló seu irmão e sua riqueza, e também as mulheres e gente.
verses.en_web: He brought back all the goods, and also brought back his relative, Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the other people.
verses.en_bbe: And he got back all the goods, and Lot, his brother's son, with his goods and the women and the people.

verses.en: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer, and of the kings that were with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which is the king’s dale.
verses.pt: E saiu o rei de Sodoma a recebê-lo, quando voltava da derrota de Quedorlaomer e dos reis que com ele estavam, ao vale de Savé, que é o vale do Rei.
verses.en_web: The king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, at the valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).
verses.en_bbe: And when he was coming back after putting to flight Chedorlaomer and the other kings, he had a meeting with the king of Sodom in the valley of Shaveh, that is, the King's Valley.

verses.en: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he was the priest of the most high God.
verses.pt: Então Melquisedeque, rei de Salém, tirou pão e vinho; o qual era sacerdote do Deus altíssimo;
verses.en_web: Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine: and he was priest of God Most High.
verses.en_bbe: And Melchizedek, king of Salem, the priest of the Most High God, took bread and wine,

verses.en: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed be Abram of the most high God, possessor of heaven and earth:
verses.pt: E abençoou-lhe, e disse: Bendito seja Abrão do Deus altíssimo, possuidor dos céus e da terra;
verses.en_web: He blessed him, and said, “Blessed be Abram of God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth:
verses.en_bbe: And blessing him, said, May the blessing of the Most High God, maker of heaven and earth, be on Abram:

verses.en: And blessed be the most high God, which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand. And he gave him tithes of all.
verses.pt: E bendito seja o Deus altíssimo, que entregou teus inimigos em tua mão.
verses.en_web: and blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.” Abram gave him a tenth of all.
verses.en_bbe: And let the Most High God be praised, who has given into your hands those who were against you. Then Abram gave him a tenth of all the goods he had taken.

verses.en: And the king of Sodom said unto Abram, Give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself.
verses.pt: Então o rei de Sodoma disse a Abrão: Dá-me as pessoas, e toma para ti a riqueza.
verses.en_web: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give me the people, and take the goods for yourself.”
verses.en_bbe: And the king of Sodom said to Abram, Give me the prisoners and take the goods for yourself.

verses.en: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have lift up mine hand unto the LORD, the most high God, the possessor of heaven and earth,
verses.pt: E respondeu Abrão ao rei de Sodoma: Levantei minha mão ao SENHOR Deus altíssimo, possuidor dos céus e da terra,
verses.en_web: Abram said to the king of Sodom, “I have lifted up my hand to Yahweh, God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth,
verses.en_bbe: But Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have taken an oath to the Lord, the Most High God, maker of heaven and earth,

verses.en: That I will not take from a thread even to a shoelatchet, and that I will not take any thing that is thine, lest thou shouldest say, I have made Abram rich:
verses.pt: Que desde um fio até a correia de um calçado, nada tomarei de tudo o que é teu, para que não digas: Eu enriqueci a Abrão:
verses.en_web: that I will not take a thread nor a sandal strap nor anything that is yours, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’
verses.en_bbe: That I will not take so much as a thread or the cord of a shoe of yours; so that you may not say, I have given wealth to Abram:

verses.en: Save only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men which went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their portion.
verses.pt: Tirando somente o que os rapazes comeram, e a porção dos homens que foram comigo, Aner, Escol, e Manre; eles tomem a sua parte.
verses.en_web: I will accept nothing from you except that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. Let them take their portion.”
verses.en_bbe: Give me nothing but the food which the fighting-men who went with me have had; but let Aner and Eshcol and Mamre have their part of the goods.
